opening.argument: The creator presents the purported Fortnite V-Bucks generators as a test, not as a genuine way to obtain V-Bucks. The video shows the human-verification, survey, app-download, and information-submission steps these generators demand, and the creator notes an antivirus warning. The result is explicit: no V-Bucks were received, and the attempt did not work. The creator also tells viewers not to repeat the activity, a warning reinforced in the video description. Showing what the generators require does not amount to endorsing those requirements when the creator reports failure and warns viewers away from them.
